EvaluationAdmin.title: WP3 / WP4 evaluation
EvaluationAdmin.description: Content questionnaires, platform feedback, participant activity and pilot cohorts. Results contain aggregate metrics only.
EvaluationAdmin.privacyNotice: Standard CSV excludes names, email addresses, account identifiers and open-text answers. The separate qualitative export includes respondent-provided text, which may contain personal data: review before sharing.
EvaluationAdmin.breakdownTitle: Breakdown by work package, country and group
EvaluationAdmin.filterNote: Filters apply to the breakdown below. Export files cover all groups, not only the selected filters.
EvaluationAdmin.methodology: Counts use unique resources per participant, not repeated attempts. A participant may appear in multiple WP areas. WP3 PRE/POST pilot grouping reflects current assignment; structured responses preserve the pilot status and country recorded at submission. Unknown country is not inferred from interface language. Averages exclude missing ratings.
